standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.keep_original: 原始 Q/K/V 留着，兼容好，显存高。
optionDescriptions.drop_original: 只留 fused，最省显存，有的导出/hook 会缺键。
optionDescriptions.materialize_on_save: 训的时候省，存盘时再补回原始 key。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.keep_original: Keeps the original Q/K/V: good compatibility, high VRAM.
optionDescriptions.drop_original: Keeps only the fused form: the least VRAM, though some exports and hooks will find keys missing.
optionDescriptions.materialize_on_save: Saves VRAM while training and restores the original keys at save time.

advanced.principle: keep_original 最兼容；drop_original 会移除原始 Q/K/V 层以节省显存；materialize_on_save 训练中移除，state_dict 保存时从 fused 权重补回原始 key。

advanced_en.principle: keep_original is the most compatible; drop_original removes the original Q/K/V layers to save VRAM; materialize_on_save removes them during training and restores the original keys from the fused weights when the state_dict is saved.
